Jarislowsky Fraser Ltd who had been investing in Bemis Company for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.98 billion market cap company. (NYSE:BMS) has declined 11.36% since April 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.91% the S&P500.
